summary: US airstrikes hit multiple Iranian sites including Iranshahr airport, Bandar Abbas, and bridges in Hormozgan and Lar roads, with three blasts in Ahvaz and two in Bandar Abbas reported. Iranian retaliatory drone strikes targeted US assets in Kuwait and Qatar, with Kuwaiti air defenses engaging missiles and drones. Israeli forces conducted strikes in Gaza eliminating Hamas commanders and destroying weapons caches.
key_points: Three huge blasts occurred in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province, Iran, per a field report at 1901Z (Source: @shin_persian/7985).
Two huge blasts were reported in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province, Iran, in a subsequent alert (Source: @shin_persian/7993).
US fighter jets struck Iranshahr airport with missiles; residents reported three heavy explosions near the airfield (Source: @shin_persian/7999).
Kuwaiti air defenses are engaging Iranian missile and drone attacks; explosions heard from interceptions (Source: @VahidOnline/77171).
IDF killed Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq, Hamas platoon commander in Shati Battalion, in northern Gaza airstrike (Source: @idf_telegram/24656).
IDF destroyed four Hamas weapons warehouses in central Gaza containing Kalashnikovs, RPGs, grenades, and charges (Source: @idf_telegram/24651).
Iranian retaliatory drone struck a US target in Kuwait per video shared by PressTV (Source: @presstv/199067).
US airstrikes hit two bridges near Kuharestan village and Shur river in Bandar Khamir, one civilian driver killed (Source: @SharghDaily/172447).

sections.executive_summary: US airstrikes hit multiple Iranian sites including Iranshahr airport, Bandar Abbas, and bridges in Hormozgan and Lar roads, with three blasts in Ahvaz and two in Bandar Abbas reported. Iranian retaliatory drone strikes targeted US assets in Kuwait and Qatar, with Kuwaiti air defenses engaging missiles and drones. Israeli forces conducted strikes in Gaza eliminating Hamas commanders and destroying weapons caches.

points: At 1901Z, three huge blasts were reported in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province, Iran, according to a field report from @hey_itsmyturn (Source: @shin_persian/7985).
Two huge blasts occurred in Bandar Abbas, Hormozgan Province, Iran, in a later alert; imagery from state-owned Mehr News showed the location (Source: @shin_persian/7993, @shin_persian/7992).

IRGC-owned Tasnim confirmed US fighter jets struck Iranshahr airport in Sistan & Baluchestan Province with missiles; residents reported three heavy explosions near the airfield and armed forces personnel are at scene (Source: @shin_persian/7999).
US airstrikes hit two bridges near Kuharestan village and Shur river in Bandar Khamir; one private vehicle driver was killed on a bridge per state media (Source: @SharghDaily/172447).
A bridge on the Bandar Abbas-Lar road was damaged by strikes, with geolocated footage from Iran confirming the damage (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5042, @lelotsenzura/93642).
US attacked a point in Veysian area of Choghadam district, Lorestan Province; details pending after review per provincial official (Source: @SharghDaily/172454).
Five missiles were reported launched from Jam county, Bushehr Province toward the Persian Gulf at 2:56-2:57; Kuwait and Bahrain air defenses activated (Source: @VahidOnline/77171).
IDF killed Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq, a Hamas platoon commander in Shati Battalion who invaded Israel on Oct 7, in northern Gaza airstrike earlier today (Source: @idf_telegram/24656).
IDF destroyed four Hamas weapons warehouses in central Gaza overnight containing Kalashnikovs, RPGs, grenades, charges and additional combat equipment (Source: @idf_telegram/24651).

Hamas sniper commander Omar Ahmed Abu Qasem was killed in Israeli strike in central Gaza Strip yesterday; he led attacks on troops and restored capabilities (Source: @manniefabian/58794, @inon_yttach/9494).
Security forces arrested several activists managing 'Union of Health Committees' institution in Ramallah, part of PFLP financial mechanism, with indictments filed (Source: @inon_yttach/9504).
IDF announced Col. Elad Tzuri entered command of 99th 'Bazak' Division, per official IDF channel (Source: @idf_telegram/24655).
Annual commemoration held for 90 fallen Shayetet 13 commandos per IDF spokesman (Source: @idf_telegram/24653).
Clashes erupted after Palestinians confronted intruding Israeli settlers on outskirts of Sinjil, north of Ramallah (Source: @presstv/199068).

IDF eliminated Nihad Riyad Abd al-Rahim Arouq, Hamas platoon commander in Shati Battalion, in northern Gaza strike; he participated in Oct 7 massacre and trained terrorists (Source: @idf_telegram/24656, @manniefabian/58797).
Omar Ahmed Abu Qasem, Hamas sniper commander in central Gaza, killed yesterday in Israeli strike; he advanced attacks violating ceasefire per IDF (Source: @manniefabian/58794).
IDF destroyed four Hamas weapons storage sites in central Gaza overnight with Kalashnikovs, RPGs, grenades, charges stored to hit IDF and Israeli civilians (Source: @idf_telegram/24651).
Security forces arrested activists running 'Union of Health Committees' in Ramallah tied to PFLP, which executed 2019 Ein Bubin bombing killing Rina Shnerb (Source: @inon_yttach/9504).
Palestinians clashed with intruding Israeli settlers near Sinjil north of Ramallah per PressTV footage (Source: @presstv/199068).
Southern Command forces deployed per agreement continue operations to remove threats in Gaza Strip (Source: @idf_telegram/24656).
Israeli forces opened fire on civilian homes in the town of Haris in southern Lebanon per PressTV report (Source: @presstv/199065).
A detonation heard in southern Lebanon attributed to enemy explosion in Zawtar al-Sharqiya per local channel (Source: @redlinkleb/31542).
Air raid alert timings for Beirut published by channel with call to pray for mujahideen (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378168).
No further specific Lebanese operational details beyond southern border fire and Zawtar explosion provided in messages (Source: @presstv/199065, @redlinkleb/31542).
Islamic Resistance in Iraq offered 10 million dollars to anyone who kills President Trump per Faytuks Network (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5037).
Strong explosion in Erbil after attack by swarms of suicide drones per Iraqi channel (Source: @naya_foriraq/83553).
Unconfirmed reports suggest US base in Kuwait near Iraqi border ablaze after Iranian retaliatory strikes (Source: @presstv/199064).
Iranian drones hit Iraq-Kuwait border per uncensored security news channel (Source: @lelotsenzura/93643).
Pakistani forces in Saudi Arabia placed on alert for possible combat against Houthi rebels if escalation continues per Reuters (Source: @pkpoi/143318).
Kuwaiti army announced air defenses engaging Iranian missile and drone attacks; explosions from interceptions heard, citizens told follow safety (Source: @VahidOnline/77171, @asafroz/51520).
Bahrain civil defense activated sirens; Iran claimed strike on US Fifth Fleet base; Bahraini officials gave no details (Source: @VahidOnline/77171).
Qatar capital Doha heard explosions per Reuters witnesses; government alert sent to citizens' phones (Source: @N12chat/217801, @VahidOnline/77174).
King Fahd causeway, 25km bridge connecting Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, remains open despite Iranian attack attempts (Source: @kianmeli1/89334).
US Apache helicopters patrolled Bahrain skies to intercept Iranian suicide drones (Source: @naya_foriraq/83560).
Reports of attacks on US bases in Qatar emerged; no threat cleared in Doha until 4:23 update (Source: @kianmeli1/89323, @VahidOnline/77174).
Arab sources reported explosions heard in Jordan, Bahrain and Kuwait (Source: @kianmeli1/89321).

key_developments: US fighter jets struck Iranshahr airport in Sistan & Baluchestan with missiles; three heavy explosions reported near airfield, IRGC Tasnim confirmed (Source: @shin_persian/7999).
Kuwaiti air defenses engaging Iranian missile and drone attacks from Jam county Bushehr; explosions heard from interceptions, citizens alerted (Source: @VahidOnline/77171).
Three huge blasts in Ahvaz Khuzestan and two in Bandar Abbas Hormozgan reported at 1901Z and later per field monitors (Source: @shin_persian/7985, @shin_persian/7993).
IDF killed Hamas platoon commander Nihad Arouq in northern Gaza airstrike; he joined Oct 7 invasion and trained terrorists (Source: @idf_telegram/24656).
US airstrikes hit two bridges near Kuharestan and Shur river Bandar Khamir; one civilian driver killed per state media (Source: @SharghDaily/172447).
Iranian retaliatory drone struck US target in Kuwait; unconfirmed US base near Iraq border ablaze per PressTV (Source: @presstv/199067, @presstv/199064).
Doha Qatar explosions heard per Reuters; government sent phone alerts, threat eliminated at 4:23 per recipient message (Source: @N12chat/217801, @VahidOnline/77174).
sections.threat_assessment: Iranian retaliatory strikes now directly target US assets across Kuwait, Qatar, and Bahrain with missiles and drones launched from Bushehr and border areas, indicating expanded confrontation beyond Iran's borders. US airstrikes on Iranian infrastructure including airports and bridges suggest intent to degrade capability, with CBS warning further strikes on vital infrastructure if Iran does not respond decisively. Kuwaiti and Bahraini air defenses are actively engaged, and Islamic Resistance in Iraq issued assassination bounty, raising multi-front threat to US personnel. Israeli operations in Gaza continue with precise eliminations of Oct 7 perpetrators, sustaining localized but persistent threat.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states activated air defenses and civil sirens: Kuwait engaged drones/missiles, Bahrain sounded alarms near US Fifth Fleet base, Qatar sent citizen alerts after Doha blasts. Saudi-Bahrain King Fahd causeway remained open despite threats. Pakistan positioned forces in Saudi Arabia on alert for Houthi combat per Reuters, showing regional realignment. White House stated Trump open to diplomacy but Iran must pay consequences for Strait terrorism, while Arab sources noted Iran seeks deal per Lezvut report.
sections.intelligence_notes: Messages indicate simultaneous multi-province Iranian missile activity from Bushehr (5 missiles) and possible Tabriz launches, with geolocated damage to Bandar Abbas-Lar bridge confirming strike efficacy. Iranian state channels (Tasnim, Mehr) acknowledge US strikes, suggesting controlled narrative. Israeli arrests of PFLP-linked Ramallah institution staff reveal ongoing financial warfare. Lack of confirmed casualty figures in most Iranian strikes and unverified base fires in Kuwait/Qatar requires corroboration. White House leak on Iran deal talk contrasts with active hostilities.
